name: Otonari-san no Yoru no Kao
source:
"How much do you know about your neighbor?"

Kirue Kiryu... the breath of fresh air who lives next door.

Yukio (protagonist) and Kirue cross paths daily, but recently they've become closer friends.
But Yukio then saw a side of Kirue he shouldn't have...

Certain circumstances led Yukio to a paid sex house, where he discovered Kirue was working at night.

Feeling suddenly disgraceful and impure, he nevertheless paid her to be a companion.

She was a true professional. And thus their relationship entered a new (client + service) phase.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ110761.html?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“你对自己的邻居了解多少？”

桐生绢惠……住在隔壁的清爽大姐姐。

幸男（主人公）与绢惠每天都会照面，最近两人的关系更是亲近了不少。
然而，幸男却看到了绢惠不为人知的一面……

因为某些缘故，幸男来到了一家风俗店，结果发现绢惠晚上竟在这里工作。

他顿时感到一种背德与不洁感，却还是花钱点名要她服侍。

她是个十足的专业人士。就这样，两人的关系迈入了全新的（客人＋服务）阶段。
